messages.content: The $20.54 overage was denied, so please do the final hotel comparison against the Union Station fallback. Include every required charge, transportation to the forum, breakfast timing, and whether either hotel will hold my bag Saturday after checkout.

I rechecked both for Thursday and Friday nights. The forum hotel is $398 before tax and $437.54 total, with no destination fee. The Union Station property is $318 before tax, plus tax and a required $12 nightly facilities charge, for a final total of $356.52. That charge is already included in the quoted total.
What are the payment and cancellation terms? The earlier deadline on Union Station was my concern.

The forum rate takes a card guarantee and allows cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Mountain on Tuesday, two days before arrival; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. Union Station also requires a card guarantee, but free cancellation ends at 4:00 p.m. Mountain on Monday. Its late-cancellation penalty is the full two-night stay. Both are payable at checkout rather than prepaid.
And the practical difference once I add transportation? I need to be at the opening Thursday morning and stay through Friday dinner.

The forum hotel needs only the airport transfers, estimated at $82, because all scheduled events are on-site. Union Station needs airport rail plus four rideshare trips for Thursday and Friday, estimated at $103 total. With the fixed $301 airfare, the complete comparisons are $820.54 for the forum hotel and $760.52 for Union Station.
Check breakfast and Saturday luggage storage too. My flight is not until the afternoon now, so I cannot carry the suitcase around after checkout.

The forum hotel serves breakfast 6:30-10:00 a.m. Saturday; it is not included in the rate. Union Station serves breakfast 7:00-11:00 a.m., and the facilities charge includes a $10 daily food-and-beverage credit. Both front desks confirmed complimentary same-day luggage storage after checkout, with pickup before your airport trip.

Reserve Union Station. The total is comfortably under the $800 allowance, and the bag hold solves Saturday. Make sure the required fee is on the confirmation and note the Monday cancellation deadline.

Union Station is reserved for Thursday and Friday nights at $356.52 total, including tax and both $12 facilities charges. Payment is due at checkout. Free cancellation ends Monday at 4:00 p.m. Mountain; after that, the full stay is charged. Complimentary Saturday luggage storage is noted. With $301 airfare and $103 estimated local transportation, the trip total is $760.52, leaving $39.48 within the allowance. The flights still need to be ticketed.
